note: Searched means an initial search attempt, not completed research. Cultural labels are research leads, not verified attributes of individual recordings.
limitations: Search breadth is not musical representation. 26 of the 30 additions in this release are by Kevin MacLeod; independent artist and non-Western performer representation remain significant gaps. Cross-cultural visuals and modern borrowed instrumentation must not be presented as traditional music provenance.
